tests.renormalize: No exact yield, stat, rate, size or variant count is pinned by says or its pictures; tuning checks and rules may change while this comparison remains true.

checks.what: Record source/assembly/compose fingerprints, actual loaded package and all-DLC identity; no per-biome heat fields, worldgen scoring, cut mechanic reachability or invented canon leakage. Existing source_guards is partial and contains stale heat expectations.
Parse actual allowed paint masks, completed foundation affordances, cardinal pool clusters and configured path/area/geometry ranges; record exact defaults as checks, not bar text.

Record actual effective radius, eligibility reason, local grievance, pressure, quiet scopes and expiry, drop placement and absolute victim deadlines; mutation controls must reject constant/wrong-map observations.
Keep production RM_PoolKernel and relevant Source/SelfTest/FeverWoodFuzz.cs coverage; add counterexample replay for new locality/authority/deadline state. A green mock suite is not runtime proof.

Parse wildAnimals/wildPlants as XML element names after available patches; note other homes without evictions, positive animalDensity and actual native membership. Local inline XML scan found no second home for the retained fauna; missing external patches prevent a complete multi-home claim.

Capture ordinary per-plant products, spoilage, herd calm/fullness, gather completion/cancellation, native drinking need changes, original ambush origin and flight-tracker state. Existing flora_harvest and bough_soil chains are partial.
Record emitter identity, current live population, call intervals, active hush reasons and restore order including sentinel fatal despawn/load. Counts do not replace listening.

Enumerate exact saved fields/defaults and actual effects, all-off and re-enable; next-version controls default off and label their status. Defaults under test are the proposed version, not the current many-features-on file.

For each switch-off ticket read fresh-map absence of active things/jobs/letters/incidents/stock/payload and clean log; enable-arm presence uses actual supported sources. Dormant compatibility definitions may still resolve.

Round-trip mid-seizure, mid-withdrawal, grievance and overlapping hush; reconcile same IDs, deadlines, drop ledgers and active reasons without fixture replay; drop dangling references with recorded outcomes.
Record terrain/plant/animal/job/food and event time series across the full-map season plus day-100 extension; actual and model ledgers must reconcile, including second-order task replay.

Inherited floor: loaded composition clean, no new log errors, real effective superb Mod Settings and ordinary supported all-off behaviour. Fix the code or stale checks; a red regression row alone is not a rejection bar.

rules.rule: Use the existing local placement order: solid bole placement, pool scatter, allowed-ground causeway passes, then residual-soil marsh refusal. Reuse those engines; no world tiles or planet seeds are generated. A failed placement cannot be patched by painting an acceptance pad.

Crown height is represented by terrain/art; ordinary pawns, enemies and visitors walk directly on/off. Fertile bough-soil and Heavy-supported crown/stilts differ from untreated marsh and unbridgeable mirror water; no exclusive friendly access.

Use cardinal-connected registered water clusters, Euclidean cell-centre distance from the nearest water cell and an unobstructed line to the pawn. Proposed engineering start: reach r(A)=min(12,1+sqrt(A)/4) cells for area A; expose the curve through the owning water profile. Both implicit Tenant and visible snare/lash use that same size envelope, with role timers/line targeting inside it. Roof and raised paint alone grant no water immunity; solid intervening obstacles block strikes. Attack the curve before weakening shore or work bars.

Apply the effective water decision in this order: supported biome and enabled feature; living/spawned eligible target; native truce; permanent map defeat; active map relief; active pool relief; pool grievance/ordinary rates; geometry and role. No second service bypasses this result. Existing seizure obligations resolve independently of later adult relief; only physical rescue, recorded loss/death/removal or explicit feature-disable resolves them.

Water downing creates an absolute saved deadline once per victim, not repeatedly extended by the next snare tick. Ordinary carrying begun before expiry clears it once; dropping then permits only a fresh valid strike, not resurrection of an old obligation. Dead/despawned/world-transferred references resolve with a readable terminal reason. Deadline duration is tunable and calibrated by actual path-and-pickup time, not straight-line proximity.

Local porter grievance is permanent on its affected surviving water cells: a connected component inherits grievance if it contains an aggrieved cell; split components inherit only their aggrieved cells, merge inherits any. Removing all affected water cells removes that local history, never transfers it to a nearest unrelated pool. Attack ends gifts and raises local hostile eligibility/rate; it cannot override earned quiet. Read-only observations never write agitation.

Ordinary withdrawal/sever quiet applies to the affected pool, including withdrawal of its active attackers; sever quiet outlasts ordinary retreat. Moderate eye damage quiets the map; severe/fatal damage permanently defeats its adult. Quiet gates both hostile water and porter rewards. Existing rescue obligations are neither extended nor forgiven by combat. Next-version suppression retains its documented map-wide adult scope but is off here.

Keep the production pressure/large-cluster eye eligibility shape and the documented rare-opportunity chance; finite limb linger and ordinary capacity remain enabled. Pressure counts actual encounter opportunities; unsuccessful allocation cannot announce a nonexistent eye. Great-emergence placements must stay within the qualifying connected pool and must not wipe existing pawns/buildings. Expanded offering/noise triggers and ransom multipliers are off.

Preserve every retained roster row; no terrain-biased spawn split. Use ordinary plant harvest, vanilla glow, shearing, tree diet and corpse ingestion; silloch attacks remain bounded to its saved initial ambush origin. Tamed silloch only ambushes hostiles. No native chase predator or acid-trail disposal. With operative thirst, eligible roster natives drink home water and neither Tenant nor snares seize them; cistrel supplies ordinary safe local drinking for non-natives.

Keep the shared calm-gather gate and its local-threat rule, including tamed herds and an interrupted gather. Far-side danger alone does not dry a sheltered herd; saved calm/fullness recover under the shared clock. Deferring the guild defenses never bypasses this gate for thornbugs or the existing drommath sap.

Use CreatureBehaviors named hush reasons as the sole silence authority. Living-bird calls consult that state alongside existing work ambience; no prerecorded population chorus. Sentinel and water events add/remove their own reasons and reload reconstructs without duplicate registration. Keep visible action/victim/loss notice even with no birds or muted audio; do not mute weather or machines.

The standing global Direct Sun geometric model applies; air temperature stays vanilla. No FeverWood heatKind, heatOffsetC or shade exception. Read actual tree/roof geometry; where the shared tree-shade prerequisite is unmet, report it, never invent a local sun rule.

Shipped default enables kept land/life/signature and disables each next-version effect, including external gates when available. Keep code, defs, art and old-save identity for deferred extras; remove default discoverability, work, stock, incidents and side effects. Dormant load identity is not active content. Forbidden heat and already-cut theft/rite/parasite have no supported enable path.

Expose effective controls for land placement on future local maps, native ambush, bird sound/warning, nectar husbandry, ordinary limb encounters, eye escalation and all water seizures; group shared-owner controls visibly without duplicating ownership. Explicitly disabling water withdraws limbs with a sign and safely cancels active rescue obligations without rewards or hidden deaths; preserve grievance/defeat, let existing relief absolute clocks elapse. Re-enable never resets history. Terrain off affects future local placement, not existing walkways; nectar economy off stops output, never permits feared output. No worldgen or unsupported cross-biome option is added.

All readings assert the actual loaded defaults, runtime identity and full-map feature activity. Source/mock/kernel rows alone are checks, never current gameplay proof; missing provider/state is unknown. Model calibration compares independent game exports before belief; do not self-certify adapters by echoing fixture input.

meetings.why: Accelerated shared growth, native feeding/drinking, harvesting, density, local fear and shade can produce food glut, depletion or continually dry herds. Mean product rates alone do not settle their feedback with work availability.

Porter placement, grievance, combat respite, nectar calm and normal harvest compete for the same limited trips. A quiet-reward loop may either finance effortless danger farming or starve daily work despite each component passing.

A real rescue deadline, route congestion and a water quiet transition can agree in pairs while repeated snare ticks reset the deadline or crowding makes alongside help fail. Enumerate obligations and feed worst path cases into the geometry sweep.

Actual job paths, ordinary wet-ground alternatives, water envelope and rescuer travel may each work separately but together leave no usable daily work circuit. Sweep geometry and actual pickup paths before asserting compatibility.

Transient Tenant state and reconstructed sentinel counts interact with saved local history and timers. Exact transitions and independence of observations must survive actual save/load, not just serializable kernel values.

A single effective gate per owning service plus explicit precedence distinguishes water-off safe cancellation from earned combat relief. Default extras cannot call the core; tests inspect callers and active state rather than deleting compatibility defs. This is an argued design, not a claim current toggles comply.

Ambient air and global geometric sun are independent inputs to ordinary growth/needs and route choice. Deleting the local heat exception removes the contradiction; use the shared tree-shade result without a FeverWood override. Shared-model adequacy is still checked by land/season calibration.

Geometry may let fertile lanes consume nearly all safe work space or let pool reach cover every home route; shade, obstacle lines and spawn clearance join the same cells. Pairwise foundation correctness cannot prove safe usable routes on the complete map.

Overlapping sentinel reasons, population calls, linger and reload may create permanent silence or premature restore. The timing/state model precedes an audible comparison; a flag alone is not warning proof.

Shared Tenant, visible limbs, local grievance, local/map relief, native truce, saved obligations and scheduler are currently different authorities. Enumerate precedence, fatal callbacks and reload transitions before accepting the unified decision.

observation.why: Independent observations and recovery are instrument validity, not a player experience; T_OBSERVE supplies missing fields.

branch_home.why: Re-derived from November routes answer; distinguish recognisable land from normal job dependence without numerical geometry quotas. Ordinary job routing is separately read by work.

mud_escape.why: Mud trap is an independent state machine; static marsh and real shore rescue keep the core whole.

living_wood.why: Solid mineable trunks remain land. Regrowth/sealant and galleries move to T_REGROWTH and T_GALLERIES, rather than bundling security hazards into land.

pool_reach.why: Size affects actual shared and visible strike geometry, not merely eye eligibility.

shore_rescue.why: Require a real production water obligation and normal carrying; retain nearby help comparison and readable loss.

pool_memory.why: Local porter anger and danger persist; untouched pools remain independent under a shared adult.

crown_warning.why: Living calls and retained work ambience use the same water hush; visual victim notice survives flock absence.

mirror_intel.why: Recommend retiring duplicate consumable intelligence; gate off while recommendation awaits owner. Read-only current signs remain core.

driveoff_ladder.why: Combat response is part of the one water chain; exact damage/time amounts become checks or tunable rules.

adult_quiet.why: All default water services honour combat relief; chemical suppression moves to T_SUPPRESSION and captive reseeding moves with captivity.

captive_economy.why: Prison industry is extra, including teaching; no core warning depends on it.

delayed_establishment.why: Keep the exact November intervention limitation as a future spec; no active captive establishment at defaults.

return_bargain.why: World ransom, trade and display bargain defer with their separate tickets; no default pressure or reward debt originates from them.

bait_wager.why: Normal bait jobs and delayed factions are a separate wager, not core water work. T_FRONTS owns delayed arrivals.

living_hive.why: Runner-up signature, including reaction/farm/guards/sealing subtickets; retained-under-veto history is not erased or converted to a new retirement.

broken_hives.why: Lootable environmental story is an extra; no current distinct ruin profile located.

crown_livelihood.why: Normal harvest and calm-gated nectar remain; cistrel ordinary water receives T_LIFE. Guild defenses and independent plant roles defer explicitly.

native_life.why: Normal diet, bounded ambush, native water and actual flight remain. Optional skellick theft is a retirement recommendation, with current external source unknown.

oil_opportunity.why: Oil harvesting remains a normal plant product; combustible weather/bonus/wake is a competing signature and defaults off.

supported_checkout.why: Supported identity, settings and Direct Sun are inherited floor/rules/checks. Wreck/scanner interactions move, rather than preserving a miscellaneous checkout bar. C_SETTINGS and C_FLOOR carry the remaining inherited controls.

retired_absence.why: Already-cut mechanics and dormant compatibility are boundaries, not independent player bars. No settled waiver or retirement is reopened. C_COMPOSE also checks forbidden reachability.

ordinary_walk.why: Expand the isolated walk to a complete season, mid-consequence reload and reordered ordinary work with all kept mechanics on.
